    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    int i = 0;
    try {
        while (true) {
            if (s.at(i) == '(') {

                    int c = 0;

                        count = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    count = 0;
                    i++;
                }
            } else {
                while (true) {
                    while (s.at(i) != '_' && s.at(i) != ')' && s.at(i) != '(') {
                        count++;
                        i++;
                    }
                    if (outMax < count) {
                        outMax = count;
                        count = 0;
                    }
                    if (s.at(i) == '(') {
                        count = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    count = 0;
                    i++;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (const out_of_range&) {
        // do nothing
    }
    if (outMax < count) {
        outMax = count;
    }
    cout << outMax << " " << inMax << endl;
    return 0;
}
